welcome.title: Welcome. Your hero plays by itself.
lines: d.idle plays your Diablo II hero for you: it fights, loots, heals and walks town. You watch, and you decide what matters.
It does not touch your gear or your gold. You equip what you find and you decide what to buy; selling junk is yours to mark.
Worn gear is repaired with one button, and you can order any area on the map when you want the hero somewhere else.
The Journey strip shows the path ahead. You never have to follow it.
Policies are the rules the hero lives by: open the policy sheet and pick how careful it should be.

steps.label: Watch your first fight
steps.hint: It ticks by itself after the first kill. Watch the video or the Thoughts feed.

steps.hint: The path through the game, one chapter at a time.

steps.label: Mark junk for sale
steps.hint: Mark an item in the inventory and the hero sells it on the next town visit.
